Disrupting residents. Remove basal growth to assess the base of the tree. Tree is situated in the woodland area next to 11 Saxonfield Close.Council Note:Following further investigation by the Council it has been confirmed that the site at Saxonfield Close London is not within a Conservation Area. Tree Preservation Order 226 1991 relates to trees within the grounds of Tulse Hill School Upper Tulse Hill SW2 and protects specific individual trees and groups identified on the certified plan and schedules including lime horse chestnut sycamore and other species within the school site. The trees identified in this application T7383 T7384 T7385 and T7386 are located within a separate woodland strip to the rear of Saxonfield Close and do not correspond with any individual trees groups or woodland areas protected by Tree Preservation Order 226 1991. The Council therefore has no statutory powers to determine the submitted tree works and the application is withdrawn by the Council. No tree works decision notice will be issued.
